messages:
Anya: kicked off a daytime GPTQ ops run across Llama-2-13B / Mistral-7B / Qwen-7B-Chat. Goal: gather MMLU + TruthfulQA + instruction-following spot checks for GPTQ / AWQ / INT8. will collect perf + quality + simple latency profiles.

Mike: rough resource estimate? timeline?

Anya: each model x 3 quant methods x 5 seeds ~= 45 jobs, ~50 GPU-hours (A100-80GB equivalence). expect aggregate results by 18:00 PST.

Sasha: quick smoke update after first 3 runs:
- Llama-2-13B: GPTQ MMLU -0.9%, AWQ -1.7%, INT8 -3.2% (consistent drop in arithmetic/qna).
- Mistral-7B: GPTQ -1.2%, AWQ -2.0%, INT8 -2.8% (higher instruction variability).
- Qwen-7B-Chat: GPTQ -0.3% (surprisingly close to fp32), AWQ -0.9%, INT8 -2.5%.

Sasha: full metrics attached in a CSV when the run finishes, but early sign: GPTQ tends to preserve instruction-following better than generic INT8 for Mistral/Llama.

Jordan: any instruction-bench regressions (alpaca/eval/humanlike)? examples?

Anya: Llama-2 GPTQ shows ~1.8 point drop on our instruction helpfulness rubric (short prompts). sample failure (FP32 vs GPTQ):
```
FP32: "Give me a step-by-step plan to debug a failed k8s deploy"
GPTQ: "Try restarting pods. Check logs."
```
(loss of step granularity). Qwen GPTQ preserves formatting better in these spot checks.

Claire: run command for reproducibility?

Anya: paste of the eval command we used:
```bash
run_eval \
  --model $MODEL \
  --quant {gptq,awq,int8} \
  --datasets mmlu,truthfulqa,alpaca-instr \
  --batch 8 \
  --seed $SEED \
  --save ./results/$MODEL.$QUANT.$SEED.csv
```

Mike: infra/latency notes from the profiling agent: GPTQ on Llama-2 increases KV-cache churn for long-context workloads -> p95 latency +7% at 8k tokens compared to FP32 (more small kernel calls). AWQ shows slightly better long-context latency but worse accuracy. Qwen GPTQ had negligible p95 delta.

Mike: cost roughbacks (back-of-envelope, Dedicated pricing):
- GPTQ (serving optimized): ~$5.8 per 1M tokens
- AWQ: ~$5.0 per 1M tokens (lower memory, slightly cheaper)
- INT8: ~$4.2 per 1M tokens (cheapest but largest quality delta)
(assumes batchable workload, no prefix cache hits).

Sasha: interesting anomaly: Mistral-7B GPTQ seed 4 had a spike in hallucination on TruthfulQA (drop -6.1%). flagged as outlier; re-run scheduled.

Anya: deployment profile recs so far:
- Low-latency chat where quality matters (support chat): Llama-2-13B -> GPTQ can be used but recommend Dedicated with pre-warmed KV and 10% canary traffic.
- Cost-sensitive embeddings/inference pipelines: use AWQ on Mistral for batch-generation (good cost/quality tradeoff).
- Safety/critical responses (regulatory): keep FP32 for Qwen-7B-Chat until we validate GPTQ over a larger eval set; Qwen appears promising but we need more instruction/regression tests.

Jordan: rollout plan? auto-fallback?

Anya: propose rollout: 1) internal canary (5% traffic) + eval hooks; 2) 24h metrics gate (loss/regression triggers) + auto-fallback to FP32 variant; 3) if stable, ramp to 50% then 100% on Dedicated. document the exact metric gates in the rollback playbook.

Claire: can we get a condensed summary for Product / Solutions?

Sasha: will produce a 1-pager with key deltas (MMLU/TruthfulQA/instruction), recommended quant profile per model family, and a simple rollout checklist. aiming to have it by EOD. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: scheduled re-run for Mistral-7B seed 4 at 2432111000 (queued on ded-cluster-5).

Anya: thanks everyone — will post the final CSV + short graf once the sweep completes. if you want specific eval splits included, ping me here.
